# Froe

> Froe is an inspectable coding agent for bounded work in a codebase. Froe CLI is its terminal application; Froe core is its adapter-independent runtime and public `@xfq/froe/core` library interface.

Froe CLI parses commands, renders events, and collects terminal input. Froe core owns sessions, runs, actions, approvals, integrations, lifecycle, and records. The CLI is one presentation adapter over the core.

## Documentation

- [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/xfq/froe/main/README.md): Froe CLI installation and use, the Froe core library interface, shared configuration, MCP servers, safety, observability, and development.
- [Architecture](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/xfq/froe/main/ARCHITECTURE.md): Boundaries and responsibilities of Froe core, Froe CLI, and their internal modules.
- [Configuration schema](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/xfq/froe/main/froe.config.schema.json): Machine-readable configuration keys and validation rules.
- [Configuration reference](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/xfq/froe/main/site/configuration.html): Human-readable reference for configuration files, keys, precedence, and authority boundaries.
- [Changelog](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/xfq/froe/main/site/changelog.html): Release history for Froe CLI and Froe core.

## Optional

- [Evaluation harness](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/xfq/froe/main/evals/README.md): How the repository's agent-neutral coding evaluations are constructed and run.
